coordinate_system.orientation_notes: Z is the longitudinal tube and bore axis. In the front view, X is horizontal and Y is vertical. In the side view, Z is horizontal, Y is vertical, and X is normal to the page. The front-view center establishes the axis location in X and Y; no axial origin or datum reference frame is defined.

features.description: Outer cylindrical body of the inner tube with reference wall thickness dimensioned to the bore

features.name: Internal bore with chamfers
features.description: Inner through bore at the collar end with 30-degree entry chamfers on both sides and circularity form tolerance

features.description: Collar/ring feature at the end of the tube with length defined by limit dimensions

features.name: Collar corner radii

relationships.detail: The bore is explicitly described as coaxial with the outer cylinder; the front view confirms their common centerline.
The end collar is an annular zone at the end of the tube, sharing its longitudinal axis.
The collar's internal opening is provided by the tube bore.
The corner-radius surfaces meet the collar outer surface at its two axial ends.

datum_scheme.datum_hierarchy_notes: No datum definitions or datum-referenced controls are supplied. The circled letters are explicitly identified as revision markers, not datums. The bore circularity control is datum-independent.

assumptions.text: Grouped front_view:F1 with side_view:F1 using the front-to-side projection continuity and their identification as the main tube outer surface. Selected side_view:F1 as canonical because it supplies explicit diameter limits, whereas the front-view dimension text is clipped.

Grouped front_view:F2 with side_view:F4 as the single central through bore of the tube, based on the matching tubular topology and common centerline. Selected side_view:F4 as canonical because it provides the bore limits, chamfer callout, and circularity control.

Retained side_view:F2 as a separate collar zone rather than merging it with the main outer cylinder merely because their extracted outer diameters agree; its distinct axial extent and associated corner radii identify a separately described feature.
The overall axial length of the inner tube is 16.00 / 15.75 mm (with limits of 15.75 mm to 16.00 mm), spanning between the two finished end faces.
